description: Trace one remembered note back to the call that saved it. Name a note visible to this run by its id; the tool follows only the evidence that note records and returns, for its saving call, the tool, the origin its provider recorded and a preview of what was passed, cut to max_bytes (2048 by default, at most 8192) on a character boundary. Evidence the store no longer holds is reported as unavailable, and a recorded artifact that is not this note's saving call is withheld. Tracing does not count as a use of the note. Use it when a note's basis matters before you rely on it or correct it.
